verdict.rationale: Automated dependency and code security scanning is a fair axis for a Git hosting platform, but the evidence pack never documents a native vulnerability scanner or code-scanning feature in Gitea. Gitea Actions, which could run third-party scanners, is a developer building block rather than the capability itself. The documented security features (permissions, ACLs, audit logs) are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have my repository automatically scanned for vulnerable dependencies and code security issues
